Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/final/case-30005.json runs/final-case-30005-r2

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli start --case ../data/cases/final/case-30005.json --run runs/final-case-30005-r2
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30005-r2

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30005-r2 --slot 0 --why "Earliest reachable slot separates most live pairs at 4 sigma, best thrift choice to start narrowing candidates"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30005-r2
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli state --run runs/final-case-30005-r2

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30005-r2 --slot 4 --why "Targets the leading pair one versus four which carries the highest support product, at four sigma separation, while also splitting one versus five"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30005-r2

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30005-r2 --slot 8 --why "Confirmation observation at the earliest four sigma slot for the still live one versus four pair before finalizing"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/final-case-30005-r2

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/final-case-30005-r2 --slot 19 --why "Only remaining live pair is four versus five, earliest four sigma slot to push support past threshold or reveal a surprise"
